cases.description: USCO S.p.A. (USCO), an Italian company headquartered in Modena, proposes to acquire 100% of the issued shares in Italtractor ITM S.p.A. (ITM) from Titan ITM Holding S.p.A. (a 75% shareholder) and Titan Europe Limited (a 25% shareholder), together with one share in ITM’s Indian subsidiary, ITM Undercarriage Solutions (India) Private Limited, under a sale and purchase agreement dated 21 September 2026 (the Acquisition). If the Acquisition completes, USCO would indirectly acquire all of ITM’s subsidiaries, including ITM Mining Pty Limited, ITM’s only Australian entity. In Australia, ITM distributes undercarriage components and provides related services such as track shoe regrousing, component rebuilding and frame refurbishment, together with undercarriage monitoring solutions. Both USCO and ITM manufacture and supply undercarriage components for tracked heavy machinery, serving the mining, construction, agriculture and other sectors, with corresponding market positions internationally. cases.title: GLNG Participants – Greater Meridian CSG Project assets
acquirers: TOTALENERGIES EP AUSTRALIA IV PTY LTD ABN - 52 693 850 903
cases.description: Santos, Petroliam Nasional Berhad (PETRONAS), TotalEnergies and Korea Gas Corporation (KOGAS) are participants via various subsidiary entities in the unincorporated joint ventures that make up the GLNG Project in Queensland (GLNG Participants). The GLNG Project includes various upstream gas production joint ventures and a downstream joint venture for the transportation and processing of gas into liquefied natural gas (LNG) for export. The GLNG Participants hold varying interests in the upstream joint ventures, but each is operated by a subsidiary of Santos. The downstream joint venture is operated by GLNG Operations Pty Ltd (GLNG OPL), and each party holds shares in GLNG OPL proportional to its interest in the downstream joint venture. Certain related bodies corporate of the GLNG Participants (Santos CSG Pty Ltd, PAPL (Upstream) Pty Ltd, TotalEnergies EP Australia IV Pty Ltd and KGLNG E&P Pty Ltd) propose to acquire assets that make up the Greater Meridian Joint Venture from Westside Corporation Pty Ltd (Westside) and Mitsui E&P Australia Pty Ltd (Mitsui), as well as some adjacent gas exploration assets that are solely owned by Westside (the Acquisition). The Greater Meridian Joint Venture is a producing coal seam gas development located near Moura in Queensland’s Bowen Basin. Currently, approximately 90% of the gas produced by the Greater Meridian Joint Venture is supplied to GLNG under a gas supply agreement until 2034, with the remainder supplied to domestic gas customer Queensland Nitrates. Westside has a 51% interest, and Mitsui has a 49% interest in this joint venture. Westside’s adjacent assets are undeveloped gas resources. Santos (ASX: STO) is an ASX-listed oil and gas company that operates across Australia, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste and the United States of America. In Australia, Santos supplies gas to wholesale customers in both Eastern Australia and Western Australia. PETRONAS is a global energy company owned by the Government of Malaysia. In Australia, PETRONAS has equity interests in a number of Australian gas exploration and production permits, including interests located in the Northern Territory. TotalEnergies is a French listed multi-energy company that produces and markets fuels, natural gas and electricity. In Australia, a subsidiary of TotalEnergies is also a participant in the Ichthys LNG Project in the Northern Territory (has 26% interest), various interests in gas exploration permits in offshore Western Australia and the Northern Territory. KOGAS is a South Korean state-owned oil and gas company that supplies natural gas in South Korea. In Australia, it has offtake agreements from the GLNG Project and a 10% interest in the Prelude floating LNG project located the Browse Basin in Western Australia. Westside is an oil and gas producer owned by Landbridge Group, a Chinese multinational company that targets investments in Northern Australia. Westside has no other assets that currently produce gas in Queensland or Eastern Australia. Mitsui is an Australian subsidiary company that owns and manages oil and gas interests on behalf of Mitsui & Co., Ltd, which is a conglomerate headquartered in Japan. It holds various interests in a number of oil and gas projects across Eastern Australia and Western Australia.

The core services supplied by BetMakers to support fixed odds wagering operations in Australia are: Apollo, a white-label betting engine that provides the WSP customer with a ready-to-use solution in respect of a WSP’s core platform architecture; RaceOdds, a racing odds generation and ‘pre bet’ software tool that provides data for use by WSPs to derive their individual racing odds; Managed Trading Services (MTS), a risk management technology service that WSPs use to facilitate the execution of fixed odds pricing, bet acceptance, customer and risk management. In Australia, BetMakers only supplies MTS as an integrated part of its Apollo software; and RaceLab, a form and analytics data service, which provides form and analytical insights about racing events based on automated algorithms.

cases.description: Schmitz Cargobull Victoria Holding (SCBV) holds a 75% interest in Freighter Group Pty Ltd (Freighter Group), with options to increase its interest to 100%. Freighter Group is an Australian trailer manufacturer. SCBV is a special purpose vehicle owned by Schmitz Cargobull Australia Holding Pty Ltd (SCBA), a wholly owned subsidiary of Schmitz Cargobull AG. Brown & Hurley Group Pty Ltd (Brown & Hurley) proposes to invest in SCBV through its wholly owned subsidiary B&H Trailers Pty Ltd (BH). BH will provide a convertible note and loan facility to fund SCBV's increased shareholding in Freighter Group (the Acquisition). If the note is converted, BH will hold a 25% interest in SCBV and an indirect minority interest in Freighter Group. The Acquisition also establishes a joint venture between SCBA and BH, described below. Goods or services supplied by the parties Brown & Hurley is an Australian truck and trailer dealer group operating in Queensland and northern New South Wales. It sells new and used trucks and heavy-duty trailers, and provides servicing, repairs and parts. Schmitz Cargobull AG is a European trailer manufacturer. Its former Australian subsidiary, Schmitz Cargobull Pty Ltd (SCB AU), ceased operations on 31 May 2025. Freighter Group is an Australian manufacturer and supplier (through its own dealership network) of refrigerated trailers, non-refrigerated trailers, spare parts, servicing, fibreglass composite panels and telematics. Transaction structure The Acquisition involves BH acquiring an indirect minority interest in Freighter Group through its 25% interest in SCBV. The Acquisition also establishes an unincorporated joint venture (JV) between Brown & Hurley and SCBA in their capacity as shareholders of SCBV, the majority owner of Freighter Group. Under the JV, both shareholders will refer certain business opportunities related to specific product lines (JV Product Lines) to SCBV. The referral mechanism applies to opportunities to: a. acquire businesses that manufacture, assemble, distribute or sell JV Product Lines; or b. sell, distribute or deal in JV Product Lines. SCBV's board will decide within a specified timeframe whether to pursue referred opportunities. If SCBV declines or does not respond, the referring shareholder may pursue the opportunity independently. The referral regime applies only to the JV Product Lines which means tautliners, semi-trailers, skels, refrigerated and dry freight vans, trailers and rigid bodies, tippers, truck body and dog tippers, live bottom trailers (excluding walking floors), and rigids. Brown & Hurley anticipates that the JV may result in its current retail trailer partners terminating their distribution agreements with Brown & Hurley. If they do not, Brown & Hurley is likely to terminate these agreements.

cases.description: Airbus SE (Airbus), Thales S.A. (Thales), and Leonardo S.p.A. (Leonardo) propose to form a new joint venture (JV) to combine their respective space businesses (the Acquisition). Airbus is a listed European public company, globally active in aeronautics, space, and defence-related sectors. In Australia, Airbus DS is active in: the prime contracting for telecom satellites – i.e. designing, developing, manufacturing, integrating, testing, delivering and commercialising telecom satellites as per the client’s specifications; the provision and distribution of satellite Earth-observation (or ‘EO’) services – i.e. services that allow the monitoring and analysis of natural and man-made phenomena on the Earth’s surface, in the atmosphere, and in the oceans, through collecting, processing, and distributing data and images acquired by sensors mounted on EO satellites orbiting Earth; and the provision and distribution of satellite communication (or ‘satcom’) services – i.e. services that allow telecom, broadcasting and data communications through the use of a wide range of radio waves received and relayed by a telecom satellite. Thales and Leonardo are also listed European public companies, globally active in defence, aerospace, cyber and digital, and aircraft related sectors. Thales and Leonardo are active throughout the space industry value chain through their co-controlled joint ventures, Thales Alenia Space and Telespazio, which together form the Space Alliance. In Australia, the Space Alliance is active in: the prime contracting for telecom satellites, the provision and distribution of satellite Earth-observation services; and the supply of ground systems – i.e. the design, construction, integration and testing of all Earth-based infrastructure products which support, control and utilise the satellite or space infrastructure deployed in space. cases.description: Danfoss A/S (Danfoss) proposes to acquire sole control of Alfa Gomma S.p.A. in liquidazione (Alfagomma) (with the exception of certain assets) by way of a share purchase agreement (the Acquisition). Danfoss is a family and foundation owned limited liability company established in Denmark, controlled by the Bitten & Mads Clausen’s Foundation. Alfagomma is currently undergoing voluntary liquidation. A board of receivers was appointed by the Court of Milan on 27 May 2025 with authority to identify and pursue strategic alternatives and operational measures deemed appropriate to ensure stable ongoing operations and to protect the value of Alfagomma’s business. Danfoss and Alfagomma overlap in the supply of hydraulic hoses and fittings and industrial hoses and fittings.

McCormick is a US-headquartered, publicly listed global manufacturer, marketer and distributor of spices, herbs, seasoning mixes, sauces, condiments and other flavour-related products. McCormick operates through two business segments: Consumer, through which it supplies products to customers via retail channels, and Flavour Solutions, through which it supplies food service customers and food manufacturers with products and customised flavouring solutions. Unilever Foods is one of Unilever business groups, and it comprises a portfolio of about 75 brands. Unilever Foods’ business areas can be categorised into condiments (including mayonnaise, ketchup and mustards), cooking aids and mini meals (including soups, bouillons, seasonings, recipe sauces, ready meals and gravy products), and Unilever Food Solutions, through which it provides products and solutions to food service customers. Unilever is a UK-headquartered, fast-moving consumer goods group listed on the London Stock Exchange and Euronext Amsterdam. McCormick and Unilever Foods overlap primarily in the retail supply of recipe mixes, side dishes and bottled sauces in Australia.
